tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /bde mgon gyi las rim nyung ngur bsdus pa bzhugs so/ /gu ru ā nanda ratna dharma dhwa dza shrī bha dra na mo/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/
༄༅/ /bde mgon gyi las rim nyung ngur bsdus pa bzhugs so/ /gu ru ā nanda ratna dharma dhwa dza shrī bha dra na mo/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bde mgon gyi las rim nyung ngur bsdus pa bzhugs so// gu ru ā nanda ratna dharma dhwa dza shrī bha dra na mo// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag ni he ru kar gyur nas// sems can thams cad he ru ka'i// go 'phang la ni 'god par bgyi//

zhes lan gsum brjod nas/ ngag tu/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor/ khaṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor/ laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du suṃ las ri rab lhun po sna tshogs padma nyi ma'i steng du/ rang nyid 'khor lo bde mchog lhan skyes sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ khro zhal spyan gsum dang ldan pa zhal bgrad pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i cod pan spyi bor bcings pa'i rtse mor nor bu/ logs g.yas su sna tshogs rdo rje/ g.yon du zla ba phyed pa/ phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs dang*/ zhabs g.yas kyi 'og tu dus mtshan dang*/ g.yon gyi 'og tu 'jigs byed mnan pa/ sku gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ de'i pang du yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo zhal gnyis ma/ rtsa zhal khro zhal rna ltag g.yas su phag zhal steng du gzigs pa/ phyag g.yas gri gug yab kyi phrag pa g.yon pa'i steng du brgyangs te 'dzin pa/ phyag g.yon thod khrag yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud nas yab kyi zhal du stob pa/ dbu skra spyi bor bcings shing sil bu rgyab tu grol ba/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang thod rlon gyi do shal 'phyang ba/ zhabs g.yon yab kyi g.yas dang lhan gcig tu brkyangs zhing*/ g.yas pa yab kyi rked la 'khril ba/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus su bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang 'od 'phros pas dbang lha spyan drangs/ dbang bskur lus gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo la mi bskyod pa/ yum la rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan pa'i gtso bo'i gzugs kyi phung po la rnam par snang mdzad/

tshor ba'i phung po la rdo rje nyi ma/ 'du shes kyi phung po la padma gar gyi dbang phyug 'du byed kyi phung po la rdo rje rgyal po/ rnam par shes pa'i phung po la rdo rje sems dpa' ste/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba rigs lnga'i bdag nyid du gyur/ yum gyi lte bar rdo rje phag mo/ snying khar gshin rje ma/ mgrin par rmongs byed ma/ mgo bor skyod byed ma/ spyi bor skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad la tsaṇḍi kā rnams kyis mtshan par gyur pa'i ngang nas/ ngag tu/ oṃ shrī badzra he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ ḍā ki ni dzā la samba raṃ swā hā/ oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ye badzra warṇa nī ye badzra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā/ snying po dang*/ oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye swā hā/ nye snying rnams bzlas so/ oṃ swa bha wa shuddhaḥsarba dha rmāḥswa bha wa shuddho3haṃ/ rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag par gyur pa'i ngang las/ rang gi mdun du dur khrod kyi sa gzhir/ paṃ las padma/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du hūm̐ mthing nag las rdo rje gri gug yu ba hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa char sprin nag po'i sku can dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ khro gnyer bsdus shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ ljags rnam par bskyod pa'i zhal nas ha ha dang hūm̐ hūm̐ gis gad rgyangs sgrog pa/ dbu skra dang smin ma dang sma ra dmar ser me ltar 'bar ba/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po na bai ta'i 'bras bu mdog dbyibs snying dang 'dra ba dang*/ g.yon gyi dang po na ka pā la khrag gis bkang ba thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ g.yas 'og ma ral gri 'bar ba 'debs pa'i tshul du 'dzin cing*/ g.yon 'og ma kha ṭwāṃ ga 'phyar stabs su 'dzin pa/

mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ dar dang rin po che dang sbrul dang rus pa dang dril bu g.yer kha'i phreng bas brgyan zhing*/ stag lpags gsar pa khrag dang bcas pa'i sham thabs kyis smad g.yogs pa/ sku las skyes pa'i ye shes kyis me rab tu 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na zhing chen bsnol ba'i gdan la rgyal po rol pa'i 'dug stangs kyis bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas su hūm̐ las las mgon bya rog gdong can nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ nag po stong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba/ g.yon du bhyoḥlas yum rtsa 'jib ma dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi g.yas ral gri dang tri shū la/ g.yon mda' gzhu dang mi mgo 'dzin pa la ma mo bye ba'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ mdun du hūm̐ las sha za seng ge'i gdong can nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis ral gri dang thod khrag thogs pa la/ sha za 'bum gyi tshogs kyis bskor ba/ shar du mkha' 'gro bya rgod kyi gdong pa can/ byang du khyung gi gdong pa can/ nub tu khwa ta'i gdong pa can/ lho ru 'ug pa'i gdong pa can/ shar lhor phag gi gdong pa can/ lho nub tu khyi'i gdong pa can/ nub byang du spyang ki'i gdong pa can/ byang shar du stag gi gdong pa can/ brgyad ka gcer bu skra grol ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ 'khor thams cad bzhengs pa'i stangs stabs sna tshogs kyis gnas pa'o// gtso 'khor thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas bskul te/ bsil ba'i tshal dang*/ nā lend+ra la sogs pa nas chos skyong ye shes pa 'khor bcas sprin gtibs pa bzhin byon par bsam zhing*/ hūm̐ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis// tshur gshegs ma hā kā la'i tshogs// bdag gi thugs dam gnyan skyong na// dur khrod gnas nas gshegs su gsol// badzra ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra e hye hi/

zhes pas spyan drangs la/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas dam tshig pa dang dbyer med du 'dres/ padma ka ma lā ya st+waṃ/ zhes pas gdan dbul/ badzra ma hā kā lā sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swa hā/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra dhū paṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra ā lo kaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra gandhaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra nai wi dyaṃ ā hūm̐/ oṃ badzra shapad āḥhūm̐/ gis mchod/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bstan la/ ma hā kā la sa ma ya ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces dam la bzhag thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis rgyal ba rigs lnga spyan drangs/ de rnams kyis bdud rtsi'i bum pas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo la bde mchog lhan skyes/ 'khor thams cad la mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ de nas rang nyid bde mchog tu gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi ma la hūm̐ yig gi mthar/ oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces yi ge bdun pas bskor ba dang*/ mgon po'i thugs kar yang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ sngon po 'od 'bar ba de'i mtha' skor du/ oṃ badzra ka wu wa wa pa sha ya ma hā kā lā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ shrī badzra ma hā kā lā ya/ shā sa na u pa hā ri ṇi/ e ṣa a pañtsi ma kā lo a yaṃ i daṃ ratna tra yā ya/ a pa kā ri ṇaṃ/ ya di pra tidzñā sma ra si ta dā/ i daṃ duṣṭāṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ma ra ma ra/ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa/ bhandha bhandha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ di na me ke na/ mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ zhes pa'i sngags phreng gi skor ba gsal btab la/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mgon po'i thugs kar phog thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul te/ byin rlabs dang dngos grub thams cad 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs pa'i tshul du mgon po'i zhal nas thon/ rang gi zhal du zhugs shing thugs kar thim par bsam/ de'i tshe mgon po 'khor bcas las/ sprul pa'i pho nya dpag tu med pa phyogs bcur spros pas dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad rdul phran bzhin du brlag par byed cing zhi rgyas dbang gsum gyi phrin las kyang ji ltar bsgo ba bzhin thogs med du bsgrubs par bsam la/

gong gi sngags rkyang pa la bde mchog gi yi ge bdun pa dang sbrel nas stong phrag la sogs pa rtse gcig tu bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas bzlas pas skyo na/ dang po ni bde mchog gi gtor ma gzhung bzhin 'bul ba ni/ oṃ khaṇḍa ro he huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor kha dog sngon po gzhu lta bu ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du kaṃ las byung ba'i mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum la gnas pa'i a las thod pa dum bu gcig pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba'i nang du/ dbus su hūm̐ las dri chu hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ shar du oṃ las dri chen oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ byang du khaṃ las klad pa khaṃ gyis mtshan pa/ nub tu aṃ las byang sems aṃ gis mtshan pa/ lhor trāṃ las rakta trāṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng gi dbus su hūm̐ las mi'i sha hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ shar lhor lāṃ las ba glang gi sha lāṃ gyis mtshan pa/ lho nub tu māṃ las khyi'i sha māṃ gyis mtshan pa/ nub byang du pāṃ las glang po che'i sha paṃ gyis mtshan pa/ byang shar du tāṃ las rta'i sha tāṃ gyis mtshan pa/ 'og gi rlung g.yos me sbar/ thod pa dros rdzas yi ge dang bcas pa zhu zhing khol/ nyi ma 'char ka'i mdog ltar dmar ser du gyur/ de'i steng du kha chod kyi tshul du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor de'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po/ āḥdamar po/ oṃ dkar po las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yi ge gsum gyi rnam par bkug ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur/ yi ge gsum la thim/ rim gyis zhu zla ba la thim/ zla ba bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur pa/ dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang tha mi dad du 'dres pas/ bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho kha dog dkar ba/ reg bya bsil ba/ ro mngar ba/ nus mthu phun sum tshogs par gyur/

oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gu ru buddha dharma bo dhi sa twa sa pa ri wā ra/ i daṃ ba li ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ shrī badzra he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ḍā ki nī dzā la samba raṃ i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ye badzra warṇa nī ye badzra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā/ i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ hūm̐ mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs chen po// sngags kyi me tog phreng bas brgyan// sha chen rab tu gsol mdzad pa'i// khrag 'thung dpal la phyag 'tshal bstod// dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yis 'khor los bsgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsung thugs// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod/ gtor ma lag len ltar bshams la/ oṃ khaṇḍa ro he hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ kyis bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ kaṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed pu/ de'i steng du a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs pa'i nang du/ gtor rdzas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga'i phung po dgra bgegs thams cad kyang thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis de nyid du bkug par gyur/ lag pa g.yon pa dang g.yas pa gnyis ka bstan la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod pas/ sku gsung thugs kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ lha rnams kyi ljags hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i 'od kyi sbu gu can gyis bdud rtsi drangs nas gsol bas mnyes par bsam zhing*/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ oṃ shrī badzra ma hā kā lā ya/ shā sa na u pa hā ri ṇi/ e ṣa a pañtsi ma kā lo a yaṃ i daṃ ratna tra yā ya/ a pa kā ri ṇaṃ/ ya di pra tidzñā sma ra si ta dā/ i daṃ duṣṭāṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ma ra ma ra/

gṛhṇa gṛhṇa/ bhandha bhandha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ di na me ke na/ mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ i daṃ liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ ma hā kā la i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ badzra ka wu wa i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ badzra ka wu wa wa pa sha ya i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul te/ oṃ badzra ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra 'i rjes su/ arghaṃ sogs btags pas phyi mchod dang*/ snying po la oṃ āḥhūm̐ btags pas nang mchod phul nas/ rgya gar skad du/ shrī ma hā kā la sya pā da aṣṭa sto tra nā ma/ bod skad du/ dpal nag po chen po'i bstod pa rkang pa brgyad pa zhes bya ba/ dpal nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo// oṃ grub par gyur cig ha ha hūm̐ dang ki li ki li zhes sgrogs 'byung po ro langs tshogs rnams myur bsad nas// sku la mi yi sha dang rgyu mas sbrel ba'i phreng bas kun nas brgyan zhing zhal du gsol// smin ma ser zhing spyan dmar ro yi gdan la bzhugs pa'i zhing skyong khyod kyis zhing skyong mdzod// pheṃ pheṃ phaṭ ces sgrogs pas so sor bskyed pa'i me dpung chen po'i dbus su rab bzhugs nas// rab tu gsal zhing mgo bo rnams kyi phreng bas 'jigs pa'i sku rgyan gshin rje dang mtshungs pa// drag shul phyag gis bsad pa rnams kyi mi mgo ma lus bzung nas khrag rgyun 'bab pa gsol// rol pas rol pa sel zhing mi yis gang ba'i sa la zhing skyong khyod kyis srung bar mdzod// kṣiṃ kṣiṃ kṣiṃ zhes brjod pa'i skad can ca co sgrog par byed pa'i gdug pa rnams bzung ste// gcig pus sna tshogs mnan nas ka ha ka ha brjod mdzad char sprin nag po'i mdog /hriṃ hriṃ shrīṃ zhes sngags kyi gsung can pa tsa pa tsa'i sngags kyis rigs kyi lus can bsreg /sgrub po rnams kyis bgegs rnams myur du sgrol bar mdzod cig zhing rnams nges par zhing skyong mdzod// hūm̐ hūm̐m̐ phaṭ ces drag po'i sgra yis srid pa gsum gyi khong rnams ma lus 'gengs nus shing*// ha ha ḍa ḍa zhes bzhad gang zhig dus kun tu ni shin tu rab tu 'jigs mdzad pa// phyug rnams kyis ni nyin re bzhin du bdud dang bgegs 'joms dri med nye ba chu nye bzhin// dbu skra dang ni sma ra cher ser nye bar spyod pa'i zhing skyong khyod kyi zhing skyong mdzod// raṃ raṃ raṃ zhes spyan dmar 'khrug cing bsgyur mdzad kruṃ kruṃ kruṃ zhes khros pa'i spyan gyis gzigs// khaṃ khaṃ khaṃ zhes gtum pa'i shugs kyi phyag g.yas ral gris bgegs rnams la ni sgrol mdzad cing*// ru ru ru zhes khrag ni phyag gis bsnams shing zhal du gsol mdzad 'thung ba la dgyes pa// ḍaṃ ḍaṃ ḍaṃ zhes ḍā ma ru can 'di yis 'dul mdzad 'khor bcas zhing skyong khyod kyis bsrungs// kaṃ kaṃ kaṃ zhes thod pa'i phreng bas dbu la spras zhing nag po'i mchu dang 'dra ba'i sku// tsaṃ tsaṃ tsaṃ zhes gtum pa'i shugs kyis rab g.yo rmad byung 'jig rten 'od kyis snang mdzad pa// kraṃ kraṃ kraṃ zhes gshegs pas dgra bo nyon mongs pa rnams nges par ma lus 'joms mdzad cing*// saṃ saṃ saṃ zhes tshogs pa'i bdag nyid dam tshig thos 'dzin zhing skyong gang yin khyod kyis skyongs// baṃ baṃ baṃ zhes sna tshogs gshin rje ltar 'gro dri ma med pa'i chu bzhin gzigs mdzad cing*// yaṃ yaṃ yaṃ zhes rlung gi shugs kyis myur du rgyu zhing nyon mongs 'jig rten gnod byed mkhyen// bhrūṃ bhrūṃ bhrūṃ zhes nus pa'i mchog gi khro gnyer 'jigs mdzad 'jigs pa'i kha gdangs sha za zhing*// kṣaṃ kṣaṃ kṣaṃ zhes pham par mdzad cing gnod pa skad cig gis sel zhing skyong khyod kyi skyongs// kliṃ kliṃ kliṃ zhes gdug pa'i gzugs kyi srid gsum nyin mtshan dus kun nyon mongs gyur pa gang*// paṃ paṃ paṃ zhes thugs rje'i zhags pas byol song rnams 'dzin phyag gis gdul bya rnams skyong ba// sngags bdag sngags kyi thugs can thugs kyi sngags pa rnams la blo gros 'bras bu mtshungs med ster// zhing rnams skyong bar mdzad pa khyod kyis 'gro ba'i lus rnams ma lus yun ring bskyang du gsol// sgrub pa po'am slob dpon gang zhig dam tshig thos 'dzin blo ldan gus pa dang bcas pas// thun gsum du ni sngags rnams brgyad po klog byed de ni bsod nams ldan par 'gyur ba dang*// tshe dang dpal dang grags dang mthu stobs 'byor pa 'dzin dang gzi brjid rgyas pa mtshungs med ster// sa steng dang ni mtho ris su ni 'di yis bgegs kyi tshogs rnams rtag tu nyams par 'gyur//

dpal nag po chen po'i bstod pa rkang pa brgyad pa zhes bya ba/ slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta a wa dhū tī pa bai ro tsa na dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba chos kyi dbang phyug gis bsgyur ba'o// 'di la a bha ya ka ra dang*/ rtswa mi chen po'i 'gyur yod do/ /hūm̐ gang gis bde gshegs spyan sngar zhal gyis bzhes// 'jig rten las 'das 'jigs byed chen po'i tshul// bya rog ming can bdud 'dul bstan pa skyong*// dam can dge 'dun skyong la phyag 'tshal bstod// dpal ldan na lend+ra yi gnas dang sde// stong nyid sgom dang bde mchog rnal 'byor pa// nye bar skyong mdzad mgon po bya rog gdong*// bsil ba'i tshal bzhugs mgon la phyag 'tshal bstod// slob dpon smod cing bstan la sdang ba dang*// spun la khro zhing sems can yongs la 'tshe// ma nyes log lta ngag tu sgrog pa rnams// gtum po khyod kyis tshar gcod brlag par mdzod// dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes las// thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod// ces pas bstod la/ rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma bzhed dgu 'byung ba'i rgya mtsho chen po 'di bzhes la/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas pa dang*/ sems can thams cad la bde skyid kyi dpal phun sum tshogs pa 'byung ba/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bsam sbyor phun sum tshogs pa chos ldan yid bzhin du grub pa dang*/ de dag la bar du gcod pa'i dgra bgegs mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi zhing tshar gcod pa'i phrin las g.yel ba med par mdzad du gsol/ zhes pas phrin las bcol/ de nas/ ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// bgyis pa dang ni bgyid bstsal ba// de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod/

ces pas bzod gsol dang*/ /dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /ye shes mgon po 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog / ces bsngo ba smon lam byas nas/ ye shes pa chos skyong gi sku yod na/ su pra tiṣtha badzra ye swā hā/ zhes pas brtan bzhugs bya/ med na/ badzra muḥ rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa padma tiṣtha hūm̐/ zhes rlung nang du 'jug pa dang*/ lhan cig rang la bsdus te/ bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa brjod do/ /bstan dang bstan pa 'dzin pa yi// rnal 'byor bsam grub dpal mtsho yis// yang dang yang du bskul ba'i ngor// kun dga'i ming can bdag gis sbyar// rnam dag gangs ri ltar dkar dge ba dri med des// rin chen bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas pa dang*// 'jig rten mi shes mun pa rab bsal nas// mthar phyin sangs rgyas ye shes thob par shog maṅga laṃ bha wantu/
